_comment: Aura: at the start of your turn it destroys itself then the next weapon attack this turn gets +3{p}. Shape copied from dyn/blessing_of_savagery_blue (same set, same 'destroy self, then next attack gets +N' wording). Release note 'applies to the next weapon attack only' matches MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK's one-shot consumption - unused mods expire at end of turn. ATTACK_IS_WEAPON reads combat.from_weapon and takes no params.
